n-up.text: Rule for every progress display: a bar only moves when the source reports movement. No percentage reported means an indeterminate bar that says so. An estimate appears only after real samples and is labelled as an estimate.

n-ent.text: Each entity kind gets the same three things at phone size: a 56 px row, a detail sheet whose first control is the one thing people do most with that kind, and a tile. The check walks every kind in the source's own list.

n-dr.text: A draft never runs. The live automation changes only on Save. The status line is quiet text, not a banner.
